series.name: SPF 6000 ES PLUS (off-grid / hybrid 6kW, LCD)
series.notes: 6 kW off-grid hybrid with MPPT charge controller, UPS function and CAN/RS485 BMS port. Uses TWO separate tables: 'Fault Reference Code' (2-digit) and 'Warning Indicator' (2-digit) - the two tables share digits with DIFFERENT meanings (e.g. fault 02 = over temperature, warning 02 = over temperature; but fault 55 = over DC voltage in AC output while the trouble-shooting section calls 55 'output voltage unbalanced'). Buzzer pattern separates them: continuous beep + red LED solid = fault, 1 beep/second + red LED flashing = warning. Manual revision 202212.

meaning.en: The cooling fan has stopped or is blocked, so the inverter has shut down on overtemperature risk.
meaning.ur: Cooling fan band ho gaya ya block hai, is liye inverter over-temperature risk par band ho gaya.

causes.en: Fan motor failed, or a leaf/dust plug blocking the blades
causes.ur: Fan motor fail, ya pankh/dhool blade mein block kar rahi hai

causes.en: Fan connector loose or the fan cable pinched
causes.ur: Fan connector loose, ya fan cable daba hua hai

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then open the unit and spin the fan by hand.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke unit kholein aur fan ko haath se ghumayein.

solutions.en: Check whether all fans are working properly, and reseat the fan connector.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke tamam fans theek chal rahe hain, aur fan connector dobara baithayein.

solutions.en: Replace the fan if it does not spin freely or its bearing is noisy.
solutions.ur: Agar fan azaad nahi ghoomta ya uska bearing shor karta hai to fan badal dein.

source.title: SPF 6000 ES PLUS User Manual EN

meaning.en: An internal component exceeded 100 C and the inverter stopped.
meaning.ur: Koi internal component 100 C cross kar gaya aur inverter ruk gaya.

causes.en: Airflow of the unit is blocked, or ambient temperature is too high
causes.ur: Unit ka airflow block hai, ya ambient temperature bohat zyada hai

causes.en: Thermistor plug loose giving a false temperature
causes.ur: Thermistor plug loose hone se temperature ghalat aa rahi hai

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV, then check whether the air flow of the unit is blocked.
solutions.ur: AC aur PV isolate karke check karein ke unit ka airflow block to nahi hai.

solutions.en: Check whether the thermistor plug is loose and reseat it firmly.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke thermistor plug loose to nahi, aur use mazboot se baithayein.

solutions.en: Move the unit to a shaded, ventilated position if ambient temperature is high.
solutions.ur: Agar ambient temperature zyada hai to unit ko shadowed, ventilated jagah le jayein.

source.title: SPF 6000 ES PLUS User Manual EN

title.en: Battery overcharged / battery voltage too high
title.ur: Battery overcharge ho gayi / battery voltage zyada hai

meaning.en: Battery voltage has risen above the safe charging limit.
meaning.ur: Battery voltage safe charging limit se upar chala gaya.

causes.en: Wrong battery type selected, or battery quantity/spec not matching requirement
causes.ur: Ghalat battery type select hui, ya battery ki spec/misal requirement se match nahi karti

causes.en: Battery voltage sample circuit fault giving a high reading
causes.ur: Battery voltage sample circuit fault se high reading aa rahi hai

solutions.en: Measure the actual battery voltage with a multimeter on the DC input terminals.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se DC input terminals par asal battery voltage measure karein.

solutions.en: Check if the spec and quantity of batteries meet requirements, and fix program 05 battery type.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke batteries ki spec aur sankhya requirements poori karti hain, aur program 05 battery type theek karein.

solutions.en: Restart the unit; if the error happens again, return it to the repair centre.
solutions.ur: Unit restart karein; dobara error aaye to use repair centre bhej dein.

source.title: SPF 6000 ES PLUS User Manual EN

title.ur: Battery voltage / SOC bohat kam hai

meaning.en: Battery voltage or state of charge has dropped into the low warning/fault band.
meaning.ur: Battery voltage ya state of charge low warning/fault range mein gir gaya.

causes.en: Battery bank deeply discharged after long grid outage
causes.ur: Grid lamba outage hone ke baad battery bank gehri tarah discharge

causes.en: Battery undersized for the load, so it drains faster than it charges
causes.ur: Load ke liye battery choti hai, is liye charge se tez discharge hoti hai

solutions.en: Measure battery voltage in the DC input to confirm how deep the discharge is.
solutions.ur: Discharge kitna hua hai ye confirm karne ke liye DC input par battery voltage measure karein.

solutions.en: Check battery SOC in the LCD when a lithium battery is used.
solutions.ur: Lithium battery use ho rahi ho to LCD par battery SOC check karein.

solutions.en: Recharge the battery from AC or PV and keep the load below battery capability until SOC recovers.
solutions.ur: AC ya PV se battery dobara charge karein aur SOC theek hone tak load battery ki capacity se kam rakhein.

source.title: SPF 6000 ES PLUS User Manual EN

title.ur: Output short circuit ho gaya hai

meaning.en: The inverter AC output has detected a short circuit.
meaning.ur: Inverter ke AC output par short circuit detect hua.

causes.en: Loose AC output wiring where two conductors touch
causes.ur: AC output wiring loose jahan do conductors mil rahe hain

causes.en: A failed appliance or motor winding inside the load
causes.ur: Load mein koi appliance ya motor winding fail

solutions.en: Isolate the battery and AC output, then disconnect all loads from the inverter.
solutions.ur: Battery aur AC output isolate karke saari loads inverter se disconnect kar dein.

solutions.en: Check if the wiring is connected well and remove any abnormal load.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke wiring theek se lagi hai, aur koi abnormal load hata dein.

solutions.en: Growatt's official test: with the load off, set the multimeter to diode mode and test AC output - a beep means a short inside the inverter.
solutions.ur: Growatt ka official test: load off kar ke multimeter diode mode mein AC output test karein - beep aaye matlab inverter ke andar short hai.

solutions.en: Reconnect loads one by one; the load that trips the fault is the shorted one - repair it.
solutions.ur: Loads ek-ek karke dobara lagayein; jis load par fault aaye wahi shorted hai - use repair karein.

source.title: SPF 6000 ES PLUS User Manual EN

meaning.en: Inverter output is abnormal - above 280 Vac or below 80 Vac. Fault 06 and 58 are the same event in the trouble-shooting table.
meaning.ur: Inverter output abnormal hai - 280 Vac se upar ya 80 Vac se neeche. Trouble-shooting table mein fault 06 aur 58 ek hi event hain.

causes.en: Overload dragging the output voltage down
causes.ur: Overload output voltage neeche kheench raha hai

causes.en: DC-AC circuit at fault - Growatt's official test: battery only, no utility and no PV, and 06 still appears
causes.ur: DC-AC circuit mein fault - Growatt ka official test: sirf battery, na utility na PV, aur 06 phir bhi aaye

solutions.en: Reduce the connected load, then restart the unit.
solutions.ur: Connected load kam karein, phir unit restart karein.

solutions.en: Measure output voltage with a multimeter; the manual flags anything above 280 Vac.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se output voltage measure karein; manual 280 Vac se upar ko alert karta hai.

solutions.en: If the error happens again after restart, return it to the repair centre.
solutions.ur: Restart ke baad dobara error aaye to use repair centre bhej dein.

source.title: SPF 6000 ES PLUS User Manual EN

title.ur: Overload ka time khatam ho gaya

meaning.en: The inverter ran at 110 percent of rated load for too long and shut down.
meaning.ur: Inverter rated load ke 110 percent par bohat der tak chala aur band ho gaya.

causes.en: Load power above 112 percent and below 150 percent, held for 10 s
causes.ur: Load power 112 percent se upar aur 150 percent se neeche, 10 second tak

causes.en: Load power above 150 percent held for 2 s (Growatt's official trigger conditions)
causes.ur: Load power 150 percent se upar, 2 second tak (Growatt ke official trigger conditions)

solutions.en: List the running wattage of all connected loads and compare with the 6 kW rating.
solutions.ur: Tamam connected loads ki running wattage likh kar 6 kW rating se compare karein.

solutions.en: Reduce the connected load by switching off some equipment.
solutions.ur: Kuch equipment band karke connected load kam karein.

solutions.en: Stagger motor starts so two large loads do not start together.
solutions.ur: Motor starts stagger karein taake do bade loads saath na shuru hon.

source.title: SPF 6000 ES PLUS User Manual EN

meaning.en: The internal DC bus has risen above its limit. Growatt's own FAQ links this to battery settings and offers a special firmware for repeated trips.
meaning.ur: Internal DC bus apni limit se upar chala gaya hai. Growatt ka apna FAQ ise battery settings se jorte hai aur baar baar aane par special firmware deta hai.

causes.en: Lithium battery connected without BMS communication, with program 19/21 voltage points set too high
causes.ur: Lithium battery BMS communication ke baghair lagi, aur program 19/21 ke voltage points bohat high hain

causes.en: Battery type or BMS protocol set incorrectly, or comms line not connected between inverter and battery
causes.ur: Battery type ya BMS protocol ghalat set hai, ya inverter aur battery ke darmiyan comms line nahi lagi

solutions.en: Check whether the communication line is correctly connected between inverter and battery.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke inverter aur battery ke darmiyan communication line theek se lagi hai.

solutions.en: Check that the BMS protocol type is set correctly, and review program 19 and 21 voltage points.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke BMS protocol type theek set hai, aur program 19 aur 21 ke voltage points dekhein.

solutions.en: Restart the unit; Growatt offers a dedicated 08 firmware - request it if the fault repeats every few hours.
solutions.ur: Unit restart karein; Growatt ka khaas 08 firmware hai - agar fault kai ghanton baad dobara aaye to use maangein.

source.title: SPF 6000 ES PLUS User Manual EN

meaning.en: Internal soft-start routine failed. The manual groups 09, 53 and 57 as one 'internal components failed' event.
meaning.ur: Internal soft-start routine fail hua. Manual 09, 53 aur 57 ko ek hi 'internal components failed' event ke tor par group karta hai.

causes.en: Bus voltage above 400 V held for 30 s - Growatt's official trigger (FAQ calls the code 'Bus Voltage Is Too High')
causes.ur: Bus voltage 400 V se upar, 30 second tak - Growatt ka official trigger (FAQ is code ko 'Bus Voltage Is Too High' kehta hai)

causes.en: Burnt MOSFETs or MOSFET-related circuit on the mainboard
causes.ur: Mainboard par burnt MOSFETs ya MOSFET related circuit

solutions.en: Measure battery voltage and confirm it is inside the model window before starting.
solutions.ur: Start karne se pehle battery voltage measure karke confirm karein ke woh model window ke andar hai.

solutions.en: Check the battery type and battery settings on the inverter, then restart.
solutions.ur: Inverter par battery type aur battery settings check karke restart karein.

solutions.en: Restart the unit; if the error happens again, return it to the repair centre.
solutions.ur: Unit restart karein; dobara error aaye to use repair centre bhej dein.

source.title: SPF 6000 ES PLUS User Manual EN

meaning.en: Output current spike or a surge condition tripped the protection.
meaning.ur: Output current spike ya surge condition ne protection trigger kar di.

causes.en: Lightning strike or utility input surge that damaged the MOV board
causes.ur: Lightning strike ya utility input surge jisne MOV board kharab kiya

causes.en: Heavy inrush from motors, compressors or transformers on the AC output
causes.ur: AC output par motor, compressor ya transformer ka heavy inrush

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then check the AC output for a short with a multimeter.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke multimeter se AC output ka short check karein.

solutions.en: Open the unit and inspect the MOV board, which sits in parallel with the utility input wires.
solutions.ur: Unit kholein aur MOV board dekhein, jo utility input wires ke saath parallel mein hota hai.

solutions.en: Replace the MOV board if it shows scorch marks - Growatt's official fix for fault 51.
solutions.ur: Agar MOV board par burnt nishaan hon to use badal dein - fault 51 ke liye ye Growatt ka official fix hai.

solutions.en: Restart the unit; if the error happens again, return it to the repair centre.
solutions.ur: Unit restart karein; dobara error aaye to use repair centre bhej dein.

source.title: SPF 6000 ES PLUS User Manual EN

meaning.en: The internal DC bus could not build up to a working level.
meaning.ur: Internal DC bus working level tak nahi ban paya.

causes.en: Battery deeply discharged or the battery fuse has blown
causes.ur: Battery gehri tarah discharge ya battery fuse uth gaya

causes.en: Battery current limiting has tripped on a weak battery bank
causes.ur: Kamzor battery bank par battery current limiting trigger hua

solutions.en: Measure battery voltage and battery current at the DC input.
solutions.ur: DC input par battery voltage aur battery current measure karein.

solutions.en: Check the battery fuse and the battery terminal tightness.
solutions.ur: Battery fuse aur battery terminal ki tightness check karein.

solutions.en: Restart the unit; if the error happens again, return it to the repair centre.
solutions.ur: Unit restart karein; dobara error aaye to use repair centre bhej dein.

source.title: SPF 6000 ES PLUS User Manual EN

meaning.en: The inverter stage soft-start failed; the manual groups it with 09 and 57 as internal component failure.
meaning.ur: Inverter stage ka soft-start fail hua; manual ise 09 aur 57 ke saath internal component failure ke tor par group karta hai.

causes.en: Inverter stage component failure
causes.ur: Inverter stage ka component fail

causes.en: Load surge during the start ramp
causes.ur: Start ramp ke dauran load ka surge

solutions.en: Isolate the load completely and restart to see if the fault is load related.
solutions.ur: Load poori tarah isolate karke restart karein taake pata chale fault load se hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Check the battery voltage is in range, since bus support comes from the battery.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke battery voltage range mein hai, kyunke bus ko battery se support milta hai.

solutions.en: Restart the unit; if the error happens again, return it to the repair centre.
solutions.ur: Unit restart karein; dobara error aaye to use repair centre bhej dein.

source.title: SPF 6000 ES PLUS User Manual EN

aliases: Over DC voltage in AC output

title.en: Over DC in AC output / output voltage unbalanced
title.ur: AC output mein DC zyada / output voltage unbalanced

meaning.en: The manual's code table calls 55 'Over DC voltage in AC output', while its troubleshooting table calls 55 'Output voltage is unbalanced' - see CONFLICTS.
meaning.ur: Manual ka code table 55 ko 'Over DC voltage in AC output' kehta hai, jabke uska troubleshooting table 55 ko 'Output voltage is unbalanced' kehta hai - CONFLICTS dekhein.

causes.en: DC component leaking into the AC output through a failed filter stage
causes.ur: Filter stage kharab hone se AC output mein DC component leak hona

causes.en: Output voltage sensing across phases unbalanced
causes.ur: Phases ke darmiyan output voltage sensing unbalanced

solutions.en: Isolate the load and measure the AC output waveform for a DC offset with a multimeter in DC mode.
solutions.ur: Load isolate karke AC output waveform par multimeter DC mode se DC offset measure karein.

solutions.en: Check the output filter capacitors on the inverter board for bulging or leakage.
solutions.ur: Inverter board par output filter capacitors bulging ya leakage ke liye dekhein.

solutions.en: Send the fault log to Growatt - a DC-in-AC fault needs board-level service.
solutions.ur: Fault log Growatt ko bhejein - AC mein DC fault ko board level service chahiye hoti hai.

source.title: SPF 6000 ES PLUS User Manual EN

aliases: Battery is not connected well or fuse is burnt

title.ur: Battery connection open hai / fuse burnt hai

meaning.en: The battery bank is not connected well to the inverter, or its fuse has blown.
meaning.ur: Battery bank inverter se theek se nahi lagi, ya uska fuse uth gaya hai.

causes.en: Charging current on the 2nd or 5th battery-type option set too high, so the BMS has shut its internal MOSFET
causes.ur: 2nd ya 5th battery-type option par charging current bohat zyada, is liye BMS ne apna internal MOSFET band kar diya

causes.en: Fuse on the mainboard burnt, or the battery cable terminal loose
causes.ur: Mainboard ka fuse burnt, ya battery cable terminal loose

solutions.en: Isolate the battery, then check the fuse continuity with a multimeter.
solutions.ur: Battery isolate karke multimeter se fuse ki continuity check karein.

solutions.en: Re-torque the battery terminals and look for heat discolouration on the lugs.
solutions.ur: Battery terminals dobara torque karein aur lugs par garmi ke rang dekhein.

solutions.en: For a lithium battery only US2 or Li may be used; for lead-acid set charging current to 0.2-0.3 C.
solutions.ur: Lithium battery ke liye sirf US2 ya Li use ho sakta hai; lead-acid par charging current 0.2-0.3 C rakhein.

solutions.en: If the battery is connected well and settings are right, contact Growatt Service Team.
solutions.ur: Agar battery theek lagi hai aur settings bhi theek hain to Growatt Service Team se rabta karein.

source.title: SPF 6000 ES PLUS User Manual EN

meaning.en: The inverter's current sensing has failed; the manual groups 57 with 09 and 53 as internal component failure.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka current sensing fail hai; manual 57 ko 09 aur 53 ke saath internal component failure ke tor par group karta hai.

causes.en: Current sensor or its hall device failed
causes.ur: Current sensor ya uska hall device fail

causes.en: Sensor wiring harness open or connector not seated
causes.ur: Sensor wiring harness open ya connector baitha nahi hua

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then reseat the current sensor connector.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke current sensor connector dobara baithayein.

solutions.en: Inspect the sensor harness for chafing near the moving fan or heatsink.
solutions.ur: Sensor harness mein chafing ke nishaan dekhein, khaas kar fan ya heatsink ke paas.

solutions.en: Restart the unit; if the error happens again, return it to the repair centre.
solutions.ur: Unit restart karein; dobara error aaye to use repair centre bhej dein.

source.title: SPF 6000 ES PLUS User Manual EN

meaning.en: Inverter output abnormal - manual flags below 80 Vac. Treated as the same event as fault 06.
meaning.ur: Inverter output abnormal - manual 80 Vac se neeche ko flag karta hai. Isay fault 06 ke hi event ki tarah treat kiya gaya hai.

causes.en: Load drawing more current than the inverter can supply
causes.ur: Load itna current kheech raha hai jitna inverter de nahi sakta

causes.en: Battery voltage too low to hold the output up
causes.ur: Battery voltage itna kam ke output upar nahi rakh sakta

solutions.en: Measure the output voltage and battery voltage together during the trip.
solutions.ur: Trip ke dauran output voltage aur battery voltage saath measure karein.

solutions.en: Reduce the connected load, then restart the unit.
solutions.ur: Connected load kam karke unit restart karein.

solutions.en: Check battery state of charge; recharge before the load is restored.
solutions.ur: Battery ka state of charge check karein; load wapas lagane se pehle recharge karein.

source.title: SPF 6000 ES PLUS User Manual EN

title.ur: Negative power fault - power ulta beh raha hai

meaning.en: A parallel unit is pushing power backwards, or grid and AC output are cross-connected.
meaning.ur: Koi parallel unit power ulta bhej raha hai, ya grid aur AC output aapas mein cross-jorre hue hain.

causes.en: AC output connected to the grid input, creating a backfeed path
causes.ur: AC output grid input se jora gaya, is liye backfeed path ban gaya

causes.en: Program 8 not identical on all parallel inverters, so phases disagree
causes.ur: Program 8 sab parallel inverters par same nahi, is liye phases mismatch karti hain

solutions.en: Check whether the AC output is connected to the grid input, and remove any such link.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke AC output grid input se to nahi jora, aur aisa koi link hata dein.

solutions.en: Check that Program 8 settings are the same for all parallel inverters.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke Program 8 settings sab parallel inverters par same hain.

solutions.en: Check the current sharing cables are connected in the same parallel phases, and that all neutral wires are joined.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke current sharing cables same parallel phases mein lagi hain, aur tamam neutral wires aapas mein jorre hue hain.

source.title: SPF 6000 ES PLUS User Manual EN

meaning.en: PV input voltage has exceeded the accepted maximum for the MPPT range.
meaning.ur: PV input voltage MPPT range ke liye maane gaye maximum se upar chala gaya.

causes.en: String voltage above the 500 Voc ceiling for this model
causes.ur: String voltage is model ke 500 Voc ceiling se upar hai

causes.en: Very cold ambient with a long string
causes.ur: Bohat thanda mausam aur lambi string

solutions.en: Isolate the DC switch, then measure PV1 and PV2 open-circuit voltage separately.
solutions.ur: DC switch isolate karke PV1 aur PV2 ka open-circuit voltage alag alag measure karein.

solutions.en: Compare the reading with the 500 Voc limit printed in the manual specifications.
solutions.ur: Reading ko manual specifications mein diye 500 Voc limit se compare karein.

solutions.en: Reduce the modules per string, or fit a higher-Voc inverter.
solutions.ur: String mein modules kam karein, ya zyada Voc wala inverter lagayein.

source.title: SPF 6000 ES PLUS User Manual EN

title.ur: Internal boards ka aapas mein rasta toota (fault 62)

meaning.en: Communication between the inverter's internal boards has failed.
meaning.ur: Inverter ke internal boards ke darmiyan communication fail ho gaya.

causes.en: Loose ribbon cable or harness between the control and power boards
causes.ur: Control aur power board ke darmiyan ribbon cable ya harness loose

causes.en: Communication chip failure on one of the boards
causes.ur: Kisi board par communication chip fail

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then reseat all internal ribbon connectors.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke tamam internal ribbon connectors dobara baithayein.

solutions.en: Inspect the harness for rodent damage or a crushed run near the fan.
solutions.ur: Harness mein chuha damage ya fan ke paas daba hua hissa dekhein.

solutions.en: Restart the unit; if the error happens again, return it to the repair centre.
solutions.ur: Unit restart karein; dobara error aaye to use repair centre bhej dein.

source.title: SPF 6000 ES PLUS User Manual EN

title.ur: CAN fault - parallel ka rasta toota hai

meaning.en: The CAN bus used for parallel operation or BMS link has failed.
meaning.ur: Parallel operation ya BMS link ke liye CAN bus fail ho gaya.

causes.en: Parallel communication cables not connected well
causes.ur: Parallel communication cables theek se nahi lagi

causes.en: Program 23 parallel settings wrong for the installed system
causes.ur: Program 23 ki parallel settings installed system ke liye ghalat hain

solutions.en: Check whether the parallel communication cables are connected well, at both PAR-IN and PAR-OUT.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke parallel communication cables PAR-IN aur PAR-OUT dono par theek se lagi hain.

solutions.en: Check that Program 23 settings are right for the parallel system.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke Program 23 ki settings parallel system ke liye sahi hain.

solutions.en: If the problem still exists, contact the repair centre.
solutions.ur: Agar masla phir bhi hai to repair centre se rabta karein.

source.title: SPF 6000 ES PLUS User Manual EN

meaning.en: In parallel mode the follower units cannot detect the host for more than 8 seconds.
meaning.ur: Parallel mode mein follower units host ko 8 second se zyada detect nahi kar pa rahe.

causes.en: Parallel CAN communication interrupted or the host is unpowered
causes.ur: Parallel CAN communication ruk gaya ya host unpowered hai

causes.en: Host mainboard or its CAN transceiver failed
causes.ur: Host mainboard ya uska CAN transceiver fail

solutions.en: Check the parallel communication cables and the PAR-IN/PAR-OUT links between units.
solutions.ur: Parallel communication cables aur units ke darmiyan PAR-IN/PAR-OUT links check karein.

solutions.en: Confirm the host unit is powered and not itself in fault before touching cables.
solutions.ur: Cables chhoone se pehle confirm karein ke host unit powered hai aur khud fault mein nahi.

solutions.en: Growatt's official test method for this code is to replace the mainboard - request it under warranty.
solutions.ur: Is code ke liye Growatt ka official test method mainboard replace karna hai - warranty ke teht maangein.

source.title: SPF 6000 ES PLUS User Manual EN

meaning.en: Temperature sensor or sampling circuit problem - the inverter derates instead of stopping.
meaning.ur: Temperature sensor ya sampling circuit mein masla - inverter band hone ke bajaye power kam kar deta hai.

causes.en: Temperature sensors on the MPPT board and mainboard drifted
causes.ur: MPPT board aur mainboard ke temperature sensors bekar chale hain

causes.en: Real over-temperature from blocked airflow in a hot room
causes.ur: Garam kamre mein blocked airflow ki wajah se asal over-temperature

solutions.en: Isolate AC and PV, then check the airflow path and clear any dust blockage.
solutions.ur: AC aur PV isolate karke airflow path check karein aur dhool saaf karein.

solutions.en: Swap a known-good temperature sensor from a working inverter onto this one to identify which reads wrong.
solutions.ur: Pehchanne ke liye theek chalta inverter ka known-good temperature sensor is par laga kar dekhein kaun ghalat reading de raha hai.

solutions.en: Replace the 2 temperature sensors on the MPPT board and mainboard if they read wrong.
solutions.ur: Agar ghalat reading de rahe hon to MPPT board aur mainboard ke dono temperature sensors badal dein.

source.title: SPF 6000 ES PLUS User Manual EN

meaning.en: Battery voltage is above the set charge limit. Growatt's FAQ points at battery type settings or the voltage sample circuit.
meaning.ur: Battery voltage set charge limit se upar hai. Growatt ka FAQ battery type settings ya voltage sample circuit ki taraf ishara karta hai.

causes.en: Incorrect settings for lead-acid or lithium-ion battery type
causes.ur: Lead-acid ya lithium-ion battery type ki ghalat settings

causes.en: Battery voltage sample circuit fault
causes.ur: Battery voltage sample ka circuit kharab

solutions.en: Compare program 05 battery type against the actual battery chemistry and set it correctly.
solutions.ur: Program 05 battery type ko asal battery chemistry se compare karke theek set karein.

solutions.en: Measure real battery voltage; if the app and multimeter disagree, the sample circuit is at fault.
solutions.ur: Asal battery voltage measure karein; agar app aur multimeter alag hon to sample circuit fault hai.

solutions.en: If the battery brand is not on Growatt's compatibility list, request the US2 firmware from Growatt.
solutions.ur: Agar battery brand Growatt ki compatibility list mein nahi hai to Growatt se US2 firmware maangein.

source.title: SPF 6000 ES PLUS User Manual EN

aliases: Li battery can't communicate to the inverter

meaning.en: The lithium battery's BMS cannot talk to the inverter over CAN/RS485.
meaning.ur: Lithium battery ka BMS inverter se CAN/RS485 par baat nahi kar pa raha.

causes.en: BMS cable replaced, damaged, or not seated in the BMS port
causes.ur: BMS cable badla hua, damaged, ya BMS port mein baitha nahi hua

causes.en: Battery brand not on Growatt's approved compatibility list
causes.ur: Battery brand Growatt ki approved compatibility list mein nahi hai

solutions.en: Check whether the communication line is correctly connected between inverter and battery, at both ends.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke inverter aur battery ke darmiyan communication line dono taraf theek lagi hai.

solutions.en: Check that the BMS protocol type is set correctly in program 05.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke program 05 mein BMS protocol type theek set hai.

solutions.en: If the battery is not on the compatibility list, set battery type US2 in option 05 and run without BMS comms.
solutions.ur: Agar battery compatibility list mein nahi hai to option 05 mein battery type US2 set karke BMS comms ke baghair chalayein.

source.title: SPF 6000 ES PLUS User Manual EN

title.ur: BMS ka link lost ho gaya (warning 33)

meaning.en: The inverter has lost the link to the battery management system.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka battery management system se link lost ho gaya.

causes.en: BMS dropped off the bus or battery entered sleep mode
causes.ur: BMS bus se gir gaya ya battery sleep mode mein chali gayi

causes.en: CAN/RS485 cable disconnected or terminator missing on a long run
causes.ur: CAN/RS485 cable disconnect ho gayi ya lambi run par terminator nahi hai

solutions.en: Isolate the battery, then reseat the BMS communication cable at both the inverter and the battery.
solutions.ur: Battery isolate karke BMS communication cable inverter aur battery dono taraf dobara baithayein.

solutions.en: Wake the battery out of sleep mode and confirm it responds before restarting the inverter.
solutions.ur: Battery ko sleep mode se jaagayein aur confirm karein ke woh respond kar rahi hai, phir inverter restart karein.

solutions.en: Check the CAN/RS485 shield and ground continuity with a multimeter.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se CAN/RS485 shield aur ground continuity check karein.

source.title: SPF 6000 ES PLUS User Manual EN

title.ur: BMS ne poori system band kar di (warning 45)

meaning.en: A BMS-reported protection has shut the system down rather than let the battery go further.
meaning.ur: BMS ka koi protection system ko band kar raha hai, battery ko aage barhane se rokne ke liye.

causes.en: BMS cell over/under voltage or over-temperature protection
causes.ur: BMS ka cell over/under voltage ya over-temperature protection

causes.en: MOSFET or battery temperature protection in the BMS
causes.ur: BMS mein MOSFET ya battery temperature protection

solutions.en: Read the BMS's own reported code on the battery or the app before touching the inverter.
solutions.ur: Inverter chhoone se pehle battery ya app par BMS ka apna code padhein.

solutions.en: Measure battery cell voltages and temperature against the BMS thresholds.
solutions.ur: BMS thresholds ke against battery cell voltages aur temperature measure karein.

solutions.en: Correct the underlying BMS condition first; the inverter warning will clear on its own.
solutions.ur: Pehle BMS ki asal masla theek karein; inverter ka warning apne aap clear ho jayega.
